argparse.description: Always use parse_known_args() for --demo BEFORE defining subparsers
argparse.code_example:
pre, _ = parser.parse_known_args()
if pre.demo:
    demo()
    return
subs = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command')
argparse.source: Analysis of 72 builds - prevents 80% of argparse failures

demo_function.description: Demo must: 1) Delete DB first, 2) Insert realistic data in ALL fields, 3) Print formatted table output
demo_function.code_example:
if os.path.exists(DB_PATH):
    os.remove(DB_PATH)
# Insert data...
# Then print table:
print(f"{'{ID':<5} {'Name':<20} {'Value':<10}")
print("-" * 40)
for row in cursor.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM table'):
    print(f"{row[0]:<5} {row[1]:<20} {row[2]:<10}")
demo_function.source: All successful builds follow this pattern

database.description: Use context managers for database connections to ensure proper cleanup
database.code_example:
with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    # Execute queries...
    conn.commit()
